datasets.name: dashboards_by_workspace
queryLines:
SELECT
  CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id,
  COUNT(DISTINCT request_params.dashboard_id) AS dashboard_count
FROM
  system.access.audit
WHERE
  service_name = 'dashboards'
  AND event_date >= date_sub(current_date(), :lookback_days)
GROUP BY
  workspace_id
ORDER BY
  dashboard_count DESC
LIMIT 20

datasets.name: activity_trend
queryLines:
SELECT
  event_date AS event_date,
  COUNT(*) AS event_count
FROM
  system.access.audit
WHERE
  service_name = 'dashboards'
  AND event_date >= date_sub(current_date(), :lookback_days)
GROUP BY
  event_date
ORDER BY
  event_date

datasets.name: dashboard_inventory
queryLines:
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT request_params.dashboard_id) AS dashboard_count
FROM
  system.access.audit
WHERE
  service_name = 'dashboards'
  AND event_date >= date_sub(current_date(), :lookback_days)

datasets.name: top_consumers
queryLines:
SELECT
  user_identity.email AS user_email,
  COUNT(*) AS view_count
FROM
  system.access.audit
WHERE
  service_name = 'dashboards'
  AND action_name IN ('getDashboard', 'getPublishedDashboard')
  AND event_date >= date_sub(current_date(), :lookback_days)
GROUP BY
  user_identity.email
ORDER BY
  view_count DESC
LIMIT 10

datasets.name: dashboard_creators
queryLines:
SELECT
  user_identity.email AS user_email,
  COUNT(DISTINCT request_params.dashboard_id) AS dashboards_created,
  MAX(event_date) AS last_created
FROM
  system.access.audit
WHERE
  service_name = 'dashboards'
  AND action_name = 'createDashboard'
  AND event_date >= date_sub(current_date(), :lookback_days)
GROUP BY
  user_identity.email
ORDER BY
  dashboards_created DESC
LIMIT 50

datasets.name: recent_actions
queryLines:
SELECT
  event_time,
  user_identity.email AS user_email,
  action_name,
  request_params.dashboard_id AS dashboard_id,
  CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id
FROM
  system.access.audit
WHERE
  service_name = 'dashboards'
  AND event_date >= date_sub(current_date(), :lookback_days)
ORDER BY
  event_time DESC
LIMIT 200

datasets.name: deletion_log
queryLines:
SELECT
  event_date,
  user_identity.email AS user_email,
  request_params.dashboard_id AS dashboard_id,
  CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id,
  1 AS deletion_count
FROM
  system.access.audit
WHERE
  service_name = 'dashboards'
  AND action_name IN ('trashDashboard', 'deleteDashboard')
  AND event_date >= date_sub(current_date(), :lookback_days)

datasets.name: action_breakdown
queryLines:
SELECT
  action_name,
  event_date,
  CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id,
  COUNT(*) AS action_count
FROM
  system.access.audit
WHERE
  service_name = 'dashboards'
  AND event_date >= date_sub(current_date(), :lookback_days)
GROUP BY
  action_name,
  event_date,
  workspace_id

datasets.name: sharing_activity
queryLines:
SELECT
  event_date,
  user_identity.email AS user_email,
  request_params.aclPermissionSet AS action_name,
  regexp_extract(request_params.aclChangeResourceName, '^dashboards/(.*)$', 1) AS dashboard_id,
  CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id,
  1 AS event_count
FROM
  system.access.audit
WHERE
  service_name = 'workspace'
  AND action_name = 'changeWorkspaceAcl'
  AND request_params.aclChangeResourceName LIKE 'dashboards/%'
  AND event_date >= date_sub(current_date(), :lookback_days)

datasets.name: error_details
queryLines:
SELECT
  event_date,
  event_time,
  user_identity.email AS user_email,
  action_name,
  response.status_code AS status_code,
  response.error_message AS error_message,
  request_params.dashboard_id AS dashboard_id,
  1 AS error_count
FROM
  system.access.audit
WHERE
  service_name = 'dashboards'
  AND response.status_code >= 400
  AND event_date >= date_sub(current_date(), :lookback_days)
ORDER BY
  event_time DESC
LIMIT 100

datasets.name: failed_operations
queryLines:
SELECT
  event_date,
  user_identity.email AS user_email,
  action_name,
  response.status_code AS status_code,
  CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id,
  COUNT(*) AS error_count
FROM
  system.access.audit
WHERE
  service_name = 'dashboards'
  AND response.status_code >= 400
  AND event_date >= date_sub(current_date(), :lookback_days)
GROUP BY
  event_date,
  user_identity.email,
  action_name,
  response.status_code,
  workspace_id

datasets.name: inactive_dashboards
queryLines:
WITH events AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id,
    request_params.dashboard_id AS dashboard_id,
    action_name,
    user_identity.email AS user_email,
    event_time
  FROM
    system.access.audit
  WHERE
    service_name = 'dashboards'
    AND request_params.dashboard_id IS NOT NULL
    -- query execution events are high volume and always come with a view/refresh event
    AND action_name NOT IN ('executeQuery', 'getQueryResult', 'cancelQuery')
    AND event_date >= date_sub(current_date(), :history_days)
),
per_dashboard AS (
  SELECT
    workspace_id,
    dashboard_id,
    max_by(user_email, event_time) FILTER (WHERE action_name = 'createDashboard') AS creator,
    max_by(user_email, event_time) FILTER (WHERE action_name IN ('updateDashboard', 'publishDashboard')) AS last_editor,
    max_by(action_name, event_time) AS last_action,
    to_date(max(event_time)) AS last_activity_date
  FROM
    events
  GROUP BY
    workspace_id,
    dashboard_id
)
SELECT
  workspace_id,
  dashboard_id,
  coalesce(creator, last_editor, 'unknown') AS owner,
  CASE WHEN creator IS NOT NULL THEN 'creator' WHEN last_editor IS NOT NULL THEN 'last editor' ELSE 'unknown' END AS owner_source,
  last_activity_date,
  datediff(current_date(), last_activity_date) AS days_inactive,
  1 AS dashboard_count
FROM
  per_dashboard
WHERE
  last_action NOT IN ('trashDashboard', 'deleteDashboard')
  AND last_activity_date < date_sub(current_date(), :lookback_days)
ORDER BY
  days_inactive DESC

datasets.name: inactive_by_owner
queryLines:
WITH events AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id,
    request_params.dashboard_id AS dashboard_id,
    action_name,
    user_identity.email AS user_email,
    event_time
  FROM
    system.access.audit
  WHERE
    service_name = 'dashboards'
    AND request_params.dashboard_id IS NOT NULL
    -- query execution events are high volume and always come with a view/refresh event
    AND action_name NOT IN ('executeQuery', 'getQueryResult', 'cancelQuery')
    AND event_date >= date_sub(current_date(), :history_days)
),
per_dashboard AS (
  SELECT
    workspace_id,
    dashboard_id,
    max_by(user_email, event_time) FILTER (WHERE action_name = 'createDashboard') AS creator,
    max_by(user_email, event_time) FILTER (WHERE action_name IN ('updateDashboard', 'publishDashboard')) AS last_editor,
    max_by(action_name, event_time) AS last_action,
    to_date(max(event_time)) AS last_activity_date
  FROM
    events
  GROUP BY
    workspace_id,
    dashboard_id
)
SELECT
  coalesce(creator, last_editor) AS owner,
  COUNT(*) AS inactive_dashboards
FROM
  per_dashboard
WHERE
  last_action NOT IN ('trashDashboard', 'deleteDashboard')
  AND last_activity_date < date_sub(current_date(), :lookback_days)
  AND coalesce(creator, last_editor) IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  1
ORDER BY
  inactive_dashboards DESC
LIMIT 20
